correctness.rationale: Both finite-domain mixed-boundary moment equations follow from Dynkin/Kac identities with exact generator D d²+b d and variance source -2D(τ′)². Multiplying and eliminating b yields D W=v′. Positive integrating-factor representations show τ′>0,v′>0 and W>0; the converse reconstructed coefficients solve both uniquely determined boundary problems. Reflecting-endpoint Taylor asymptotics and strictly ordered mean-degenerate example are proved. 183 deterministic example checks passed; finite tests are not used as an infinite-dimensional proof.

value.rationale: The natural inverse question is whether the mean and variance of a first-passage experiment, measured as functions of initial location, identify both unknown mobility/noise and force. The result gives a complete smooth realizability region and a unique constructive recovery formula for an infinite-dimensional pair of coefficients. A regular continuum of distinct drift/diffusion landscapes shares an identical full mean profile but has strictly ordered variance profiles, demonstrating genuine necessity of the additional statistic. No paper-sized downstream theorem is presumed; no noisy-data stability is claimed.
